text: nice thanks so when it comes to images / assets i assume they are saved somewhere in the app files but im not sure if i can find it. maybe its elsewhere
resolution: Informational ask — answered with verified paths. Three tiers: (1) the editor does NOT copy a dropped image; the image layer / decal node stores the PATH to the original file and loads it in place, so moving/deleting the original breaks the editor render and the next bake skips it with a warning. (2) The material record (decal doc carrying the path + paint stack) lives in the shared localstore sqlite at ~/.local/share/reactjit/localstore.db, hmsc namespace, custom-textures key. (3) The compiled game owns a real copy: the bake installs the image bytes content-addressed (sha256 filename) into zig-out/game/contentstore/ — verified the user's jpg there (319444aa…, 51,809 bytes, JPEG 976x850), referenced by hash from the gamefile so the compiled world is self-contained. Flagged the practical caveat (keep source images somewhere stable) and offered an import-copies-into-app-data feature if they want the editor to take ownership of dropped images.
